# Interpretation of Wound Infection in Clinical Practice: Best Practice Principles (2022)

Wei Min' Jin Li² Ji Yihong³

1. Wound Care Center Drum Tower Hospital Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School Nanjing 210008 China; 2. Department of Surgery the Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University Nanjing 210008 China; 3. Wound Care Center Changshu No.1 People's Hospital Changshu Jiangsu 215500 China

【Abstract】This article briefly interprets the recently published guideline Wound Infection In Clinical Practice: Best Practice Principles (2022) from six aspects: assessment of the wound infection diagnosis of the wound infection bacterial biofilm overall assessment and management of such patients preparation of wound bed and local antimicrobial therapy aiming to help clinicians to understand the latest international guidelines on wound infection so as to improve the treatment and management of infected wounds and promote the clinical application and promotion of this guideline.

【Key words】Wound infection; Best practice; Guideline; Interpretation
